tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: The page ground. Seren is one committed dark look: there is no light theme.

tokens.name: ink-raised
tokens.usage: Raised panels and card rows. seren.css writes it as a literal, in seven places; named here.

tokens.name: ink-deep
tokens.usage: The deeper ground of alternating bands. A literal in seren.css; named here.

tokens.name: bone
tokens.usage: Primary text and headings (14.9:1 on ink).

tokens.name: dust
tokens.usage: Secondary text: long body copy, labels, table heads (7.0:1).

tokens.name: dust-hi
tokens.usage: Chip text and table cells: the brighter secondary (10.3:1).

tokens.name: copper
tokens.usage: The one accent: rules, focus rings, ::selection, the border on the thing that matters (5.3:1 as text).

tokens.name: copper-hi
tokens.usage: Copper as text: eyebrows and links (7.0:1).

tokens.name: verdigris
tokens.usage: Live, and "it held": the pulsing dot, the rule beside the player's own turn.

tokens.name: verdigris-hi
tokens.usage: Verdigris as text: a pass, the player's name (7.6:1).

tokens.name: oxblood
tokens.usage: It failed or was lost: the failure block's border and rule (3.8:1, a border, above the 3:1 floor).

tokens.name: hair
tokens.usage: Hairlines between bands and rows: 9% bone.

tokens.name: edge
tokens.usage: The 1px edge around chips, buttons, rolls, dice and tables: 16% bone.

tokens.name: edge-soft
tokens.usage: A stronger frame: 22% bone. The subnav hover border, file-table heads.

styles.name: hero
styles.usage: The hero headline: .page-title, clamp(48px, 7.4vw, 116px). The turn goes on its own line in italic copper-hi.

styles.name: title
styles.sample: Give it the bones, not the script.

styles.name: section
styles.sample: A record, not a highlight reel.

styles.name: display
styles.sample: A death in session four is still a death in session forty.

styles.name: scene
styles.usage: Scene prose and spoken lines: .pt-scene p, .pt-said.
styles.sample: Guz is enormous, apologetic, and reaches constantly for long words.

styles.name: lead
styles.usage: The lead under a title: .text-2, .creators-text. At most 60ch.
styles.sample: You play one character. It runs the world.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Nobody wrote the scenes in advance.

styles.name: wordmark
styles.usage: The wordmark beside the orbit mark: .page-meta, uppercase by CSS.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Section eyebrows: .eyebrow, uppercase by CSS, in copper-hi.

styles.name: chip
styles.usage: Chips: .chip, in dust-hi inside a 1px edge.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Labels: .label (and .label-wide at 0.2em), uppercase, in dust. The source also sets 9.5px subnav labels and table heads.

styles.name: number
styles.usage: Counts on the record: .pt-num b, tabular figures, with a label under each.

tokens.name: gutter
tokens.usage: The page gutter. It drops to 24px under 900px wide.

tokens.name: band
tokens.usage: Section bands: 112px above and below, a hair rule between. A literal in seren.css; named here.

tokens.name: radius
tokens.usage: Everything boxed: chips, buttons, rolls, dice, ledgers, tables. Nearly square. A literal in seren.css; named here.

tokens.name: radius-dot
tokens.usage: The live dot. The only circles are this and the orbit mark.
